query: Query the list of all switches in the production environment
sql: SELECT * FROM NetworkDevice WHERE device_type = 'Switch' AND idc_room = 'Production DC'

query: Query CPU utilization of the switch named core-switch-01 in the last hour
sql: SELECT d.device_name, k.cpu_usage, k.collect_time FROM NetworkDevice d JOIN NetworkDeviceKPI k ON d.device_id = k.device_id WHERE d.device_name = 'core-switch-01' AND k.collect_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

query: Query CPU utilization trend of all switches in the last 24 hours
sql: SELECT d.device_name, s.avg_cpu, s.stat_time FROM NetworkDevice d JOIN NetworkDeviceSummary s ON d.device_id = s.device_id WHERE d.device_type = 'Switch' AND s.stat_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

query: Query memory usage of all switch devices in the network
sql: SELECT d.device_name, k.memory_usage FROM NetworkDevice d JOIN NetworkDeviceKPI k ON d.device_id = k.device_id WHERE d.device_type = 'Switch'
SELECT d.device_name, s.slot_model, s.slot_no FROM NetworkDevice d JOIN DeviceSlot s ON d.device_id = s.device_id

query: Query CPU utilization of all slots on a specific device
sql: SELECT s.slot_no, k.cpu_usage FROM DeviceSlot s JOIN DeviceSlotKPI k ON s.slot_id = k.slot_id WHERE s.device_id = 'DEV001'

query: Query temperature of all slots in the last hour
sql: SELECT s.slot_model, k.temperature FROM DeviceSlot s JOIN DeviceSlotKPI k ON s.slot_id = k.slot_id WHERE k.collect_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

query: Query historical performance trend of slots
sql: SELECT s.slot_no, p.avg_temperature, p.stat_time FROM DeviceSlot s JOIN SlotSummary p ON s.slot_id = p.slot_id

query: Query port traffic of all router devices in the network
sql: SELECT d.device_name, k.port_traffic FROM NetworkDevice d JOIN NetworkDeviceKPI k ON d.device_id = k.device_id WHERE d.device_type = 'Router'

query: Query LUN group information of flash storage devices
sql: SELECT s.storage_name, l.lun_group_name, l.lun_count FROM FlashStorage s JOIN LUNGroup l ON s.storage_id = l.storage_id

Query memory usage of database servers in the last day
sql: SELECT d.device_name, k.memory_usage FROM NetworkDevice d JOIN NetworkDeviceKPI k ON d.device_id = k.device_id WHERE d.device_type = 'Server' AND k.collect_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY

Query devices whose switch port bandwidth utilization exceeds 80%
sql: SELECT d.device_name, k.bandwidth_usage FROM NetworkDevice d JOIN NetworkDeviceKPI k ON d.device_id = k.device_id WHERE d.device_type = 'Switch' AND k.bandwidth_usage > 80
